question: What carriers do we work with?
agent_answer:
We work with 3 carriers (TMS):

| ID | Name | Type | Cost/kg | Avg Transit |
|----|------|------|---------|-------------|
| CAR-001 | Kerry Express | Ground | ฿15 | 2 days |
| CAR-002 | SCG Cold Chain | Refrigerated | ฿25 | 1 day |
| CAR-003 | Flash Express Premium | Refrigerated | ฿35 | 1 day |

Note: CAR-002 and CAR-003 are the only options for refrigerated products — Kerry Express (ground) cannot be used for fresh mangoes.
